events.title: Bent Creek HALLOWEEN Work Day
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for a SPOOKY HALLOWEEN work day on Ingles Field Gap! No experience is necessary - our Pisgah SORBA Trail Crew Leaders will provide all tools, guidance, and instruction. Date: Saturday, October 31 from 9:00am-1:00pm (report at 8:45am) Trail Work Location: Ingles Field Gap Meetup Location: Ledford Parking Lot Work description: Clearing drains, tread work, and brushing TCL: Craig Ruhland Required items: Long pants, boots that cover your ankles, safety glasses (can be provided), gloves (can be provided), hardhat (bike helmets DO NOT count, but climbing helmets do, also can be provided), snacks/lunch and water. All tools will be provided. Come out and give back to the trails!

events.title: PAS Bike In Movie Night
events.description: Location: Oskar Blue Brewery Time: Doors at 5:30, films at 6:30. Ride in and use the bike parking from Brevard Bike Alliance , check out Made X Mtns and other bike industry vendors, and grab raffle tickets to support the trails. A night of short films, good beer, and good people, all for Pisgah trails.
events.venue: 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712, USA

events.title: 2026 Annual Meeting
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for our Annual Meeting as we vote in our 2027 Board of Directors, share updates on our projects, programs, and plans for the year ahead. We will also be hosting a panel discussion about this History of Pisgah. Come on out to connect with the local trail community and learn how we’re working together to build and maintain better trails across Western North Carolina! No RSVP is required. Date: Monday, December 7th Time: 5:30pm - 7:30pm (panel will begin at 6:30pm) Location: The Mule at Devils Foot in Asheville
events.venue: 131 Sweeten Creek Rd, Asheville, NC 28803, USA
